label: Local, bodily motion: Motion with respect to place of a body
term: local, bodily motion (κατὰ τόπον καὶ σωματικὴ κίνησις)
definition: Motion with respect to place of a body (Physics VII.1, 242a15-16, 242b24-25). Lean: `IsLocal r` marks the respects of such motion; the typed VII.1 regress speaks only of links in such respects. 'Bodily' (σωματική) is folded into the respect: `IsLocal` marks respects of local motion of bodies, and no separate predicate says that the movers are bodies.
